title: Rivergate and Current
author: L. M. Vane
blurb: Astrid Ravensworth, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
